# CordisX

CordisX is an opt-in local extension host for Codex Desktop. This is the entry
point for agents helping a user install, start, use, or customize CordisX.

## First-Time Adoption

1. Read the npm beta installation section of [Getting started](.agents/docs/getting-started.md).
   Check the user's existing installation and selected profile, then complete
   only missing setup. Use the published beta channel, not a source checkout.
2. For ongoing documentation discovery, follow [the documentation Skill installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/docs/main/.agents/docs/install-docs-skill.md).
   The Skill is a small navigation aid, not a copy of the product documentation.
3. If the request includes plugins, continue at [Marketplace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/marketplace/main/llms.txt)
   or the specific source guide provided by the user.
4. For a requested launch, use the selected profile's normal shared-data launch
   from Getting started. Verify readiness with `cordisx status --json` and report
   installation, running Host, plugin activation, and service login separately.

Reading this entry alone is not a request to install or launch anything. For a
question about CordisX, use the task routes below without performing adoption.

## Read Only What The Task Needs

- Install, launch, select a profile, or manage the running instance: [Getting started](.agents/docs/getting-started.md).
- Diagnose a startup failure: [Startup Q&A](.agents/docs/startup-qa.md).
- Configure a source or install an existing plugin: [Marketplace entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/marketplace/main/llms.txt).
- Create or modify a plugin: [Plugin-development Skill](skills/cordisx-plugin-development/SKILL.md).
  The CLI deploys this separate Skill on a non-dry-run Host launch.
- Find a product topic: [Host documentation index](.agents/docs/README.md).
- Find another owning repository or install the navigation Skill: [Docs entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/docs/main/llms.txt).

Follow links for the current task, not every link recursively. Resolve relative
links against the containing document's URL. Do not repeat an already completed
prerequisite when a child guide refers back here. If installed CLI help differs
from a guide on `main`, use documentation at the installed release tag and
report the mismatch instead of inventing commands.

## Runtime And Safety Boundary

Preserve existing CordisX configuration, profiles, accounts, and unrelated Apps.
Normal use does not require cloning this repository, modifying the installed
Codex application, or creating a new isolated login. Do not copy credentials or
permission grants. Installation and source selection do not authorize arbitrary
plugin effects; `--yes` confirms management operations, not permission grants.
Use `AGENTS.md` only for work on this repository, not as an end-user setup guide.
